app.title: Pump coach
banner.simulated: Simulated demo data. Not a real farm.
plan.paused: No minutes yet: first a question
plan.unmet: {litres} L short under today's water cap
plan.voice_fallback: Voice: device text-to-speech (fallback, not recorded clips)
reason.at_or_above_trigger: The crop has used {deficit} mm of water since the soil was last full. Watering starts at {trigger} mm, so put it back.
reason.assumed_due: Declared due by the demo scenario ({deficit} mm used).
reason.below_trigger: The soil still holds enough water: {deficit} mm used, watering starts at {trigger} mm.
reason.missing_input: Something essential is unknown, so no minutes are shown.
reason.contradiction: The soil check and the water count disagree.
q.ask_area: How big is the plot? Walk the boundary with the phone.
q.ask_bucket_test: Time how long the pump takes to fill a 20-litre bucket.
q.ask_method: How do you water: furrows, sprinkler or drip?
q.ask_crop_stage: What is growing, and how old is it?
q.ask_soil_test: Do the ribbon test: squeeze moist soil into a ribbon.
q.ask_moisture_check: Dig a handful of soil at root depth and check how wet it is.
q.ask_rain_since: How much rain fell since {since}? Read the water depth in your container, in mm.
q.ask_second_check: The soil check and the water count disagree. Please check the soil once more.
q.escalate_extension_officer: The checks keep disagreeing. Please ask your extension officer to look at the plot.
rain.label: Rain since {since} (mm)
rain.hint: Any straight-sided container left in the open: the water depth is the rainfall.
w.salty_water: Water may be salty: get a water test and extension advice. The coach will not add extra water on its own.
w.clay_short_sets: Clay soil: water in shorter, more frequent sets and never flood a waterlogged field.
w.steep_slope_furrow: Steep plot: furrows can wash soil away. Run them along the contour.
w.fertilizer_logged: Fertilizer logged. It does not change today's numbers yet.
w.water_scarce_no_expansion: Water is shared and scarce: savings mean less fuel and money, not more land.
w.crop_proxy_parameters: Crop numbers borrowed from {proxy_for}: check with your extension officer.
plot.soil_awc: Water the soil can hold (mm per m)
plot.deficit: Water used since soil was full (simulated)
log.inputs: Inputs and where they came from
scenario.label: Demo scenario
timer.up: Time's up: turn the pump off
check.how: Dig a handful of soil at root depth and squeeze it.
check.ok_hint: Holds together, leaves a little moisture
check.escalate_hint: Until then, no minutes. If you have just watered until the soil is soaked, you can start fresh.
check.fresh_start: The soil is soaked today: start fresh
welcome.lede: How long to run your pump today, if at all. One answer a day, in your language.
welcome.private: Your data stays on this phone
welcome.basic_phone: No smartphone? It also works by SMS and USSD
setup.title: Set up your plot
setup.intro: About 20 minutes, once. Best done with your pump dealer or extension officer.
setup.need_bucket: A bucket of known size (20 litres)
setup.paces_how: Walk the length of the plot and count your steps. Then the width.
setup.gps_how: Stand at a corner and tap Add corner. Walk to the next corner. Repeat for every corner.
setup.gps_unavailable: GPS is not available here. Count paces instead.
setup.gps_rough: GPS is rough on a small plot (about ±{pct}%). Counting paces may be better.
method.furrow_hint: Water runs along channels or fills basins
setup.map_need_gps: The soil map needs the plot's GPS corners. The ribbon test below is enough on its own.
setup.map_none: No soil map for this spot on the phone yet. The ribbon test is enough.
setup.ribbon_how: Take soil from root depth, add a little water and knead it until it feels like putty.
setup.ribbon_ball: Does it hold together in a ball?
setup.ribbon_len: Push it out between thumb and finger. How long is the ribbon before it breaks?
setup.ribbon_feel: Wet a pinch and rub it. How does it feel?
setup.soil_result: Your soil: {texture}. It holds about {awc} mm of water per metre.
setup.soil_skip: You can skip this and do the ribbon test later; the coach will ask.
setup.pump_how: Put the bucket under the pump outlet. Tap Start the moment water goes in, and Stop when it is full.
setup.flow_result: Your pump gives about {lpm} litres a minute ({lph} an hour).
setup.pump_repeat: Do this again if you change the pump, hose or water source.
setup.soaked_q: When was the soil last soaked?
setup.soaked_hint: After heavy rain or a long watering, the soil is full. The coach counts from then.
setup.soaked_unknown: Fine: the coach will ask you to check the soil with your hand first.
setup.later_hint: Missing steps are fine: the coach will ask for them one at a time, and won't guess.
season.title: A month with the coach
season.lede: Simulated for this plot: the coach's schedule against watering every day.
season.incomplete: Finish the plot setup (area, crop, method, soil, pump) to see the month.
season.habit: Today's habit: pump {minutes} min every day
season.fuel_lph: Litres of fuel per pump hour
season.fuel_hint: Your own numbers. Solar pump? Leave empty: hours saved are still worth time and wear.
season.chart_soil: Water the crop has used from the soil
season.chart_soil_sub: Coach schedule, mm. Each dot is a watering.
season.disclaimer: Simulated, not measured: one illustrative shower on day 12. Savings shown are for the farmer (fuel, money, hours, fertilizer that stays in the soil), not water saved for the basin.
pump.title: Will your pump keep up?
pump.lede: For {area} m² of {crop} in the hottest weeks, each watering method:
pump.hours_per_day: The pump can run {hours} h a day
pump.detail: {hours} h of pumping every {days} days ({available} h available)
pump.too_small: Pump too small for this area: water a smaller area or get a bigger pump.
pump.paradox: Water saved is fuel and money saved, not a reason to irrigate more land where water is shared.
log.self_reported: Self-reported: what you told the coach. Lenders need spot checks before treating this as evidence.
about.title: About and data
about.body: The coach uses the FAO-56 crop water method, an open soil map and your own tests. Every number can be checked by hand by an extension officer. It supports you and your extension officer; it does not replace them.
about.data: Data: iSDAsoil (CC-BY 4.0), Copernicus DEM, NASA POWER, FAO-56.
about.privacy: Your plot and log stay on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you choose to share it.
about.reset_confirm: Yes, delete it from this phone
phones.title: Basic phones
phones.lede: Many farmers have a basic phone, not a smartphone. The same coach works by USSD and SMS: any phone, no internet bundle, no app.
phones.ussd_hint: Dial the code, pick from the menu. Works on 2G.
phones.sms_hint: Every morning, one SMS. The farmer replies with a word: rain, done, or a soil check.
phones.agent_title: Through a lead farmer or dealer
phones.agent_body: A lead farmer, dealer or extension officer with a smartphone can keep a neighbour's plot and tap Send by SMS on the Today screen. It uses their own SMS app, so no server or internet is needed.
phones.disclaimer: Simulator: this runs the real USSD and SMS code on a copy of the plot. A live service needs an SMS/USSD gateway and a short code (see channels/README.md). The code shown is illustrative.
setup.area_big: That is bigger than most smallholder plots (5 acres). Check the numbers: one plot, one pump.
setup.area_small: That is very small. Check the numbers.
setup.flow_odd: That flow is unusual for a farm pump. Time the bucket again to be sure.
setup.flow_too_quick: Under 2 seconds is too quick to time well. Use a bigger container.
plot.weather_note: Weather: Kimana average (NASA POWER), the demo area. A deployment ships one area pack per sub-county.
